label: Desirable-insofar-as-perfect is exactly its forward half plus its backward half
paraphrase: For all types and relations DesirableIn and PerfectIn (PERFECT_1), the per-perfection biconditional 'desirable in p exactly when perfect in p' is equivalent to the conjunction of its forward half (perfect implies desirable) and its backward half (desirable implies perfect). Equivalence certificate of the strength comparison of the biconditional with its forward half; a premise-free comparison of encodings, not an assertion of either half.
